comment: #354 D3 spike: 50 natural-language queries over fetch_corpus.py's documents. 'relevant' names files (irs-*, wiki-*) or whole subjects ('subject:gnn' = every arXiv or Wikipedia document of that subject, in any language). Written from the documents' titles before any model was run; 'lang' is the query's language.
